final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS price_per_day FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost), AVG(r.avg_price_per_day), AVG(r.avg_price_per_day - o.price_per_day) FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.price_per_day IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_price_per_day > o.price_per_day
